examples.description: Find an e-invoice by its number

failure_modes.recovery: Send q with the invoice number or a word from the buyer's name.

description: Find generated e-invoices by text: every word must match one of the document's text fields, such as invoice number, buyer name or buyer TIN. Refuses an empty q with VALIDATION_ERROR. Rows carry no field sheet: call myinvois_invoice_read with the id for portal_field_sheet. No match returns an empty list: call myinvois_invoice_list to browse the newest.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor — pass a previous response's next_cursor verbatim. null next_cursor means no further pages.

limit.description: Page size 1-200. Omit BOTH limit and cursor for the legacy bare-array first page of 200; pass either to get { items, next_cursor, limit } instead.

q.description: Search text (substring match over the entity's text properties; %/_ are literal).

name: myinvois_invoice_search
